reason: 该插件面向用户在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中的任务输入流程，核心作用是把“任务草稿”整理为结构化、可执行的任务说明，属于规划与执行型用户辅助插件。它通过界面按钮触发、调用当前会话模型、基于有限上下文补充说明，并将结果回填到输入框而非自动发送，因此分类为 planning-execution 而非直接代码生成或文件操作类插件。

summaries.zh: D﻿SH Taskify 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的轻量插件，可以一键将任务草稿整理为更清晰、结构化的任务说明并回填到输入框。
summaries.en: D﻿SH Taskify is a lightweight DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that rewrites a task draft into a clearer, structured task description and fills it back into the composer.

capabilities: Reformats user-entered task drafts into structured executable task descriptions
Invokes the current session model to perform draft enhancement
Uses limited recent conversation context to resolve brief references
Writes processed results back into the web composer with cancellation/retry and rollback behavior
